selection_rule: Retain only a group with positive mean primary-metric difference and improvement in at least three of four development folds. For risk, also require non-worse High-risk recall and no increase in High-risk outcomes predicted Low. Use the minimal candidate to avoid promoting inconclusive groups.
limitations: This configuration is based on leave-one-group-out development evidence, not a direct fit of each final combined candidate.
It is not an untouched-test, trading, portfolio, or user-facing model result.
The 2024-2025 reused test period was not used for feature selection.
No SEC fundamental field is approved because the Phase 6.10 readiness gate did not pass.
The volume feature uses Alpaca IEX feed volume, not consolidated SIP whole-market volume.
next_gate: Phase 7 may tune and evaluate only these exact development candidates with chronological training-side validation; it must not add new features silently.
